title: The New Horizons signal
text: New Horizons, silent for decades, relayed a message from near Sagittarius A*: Wolf 359, Barnard's Star, Alpha Centauri, Sol. "We have tasted the quiet worlds. We are coming for the loud one." It answered a probe launched less than a century ago, from 26,000 light-years away.

title: The first name on the list
text: Wolf 359 lost a mining camp last spring: everyone gone, lights still on. It's the first star the core signal named.

title: Two signals
text: The signal from the core is not the one you've been hearing. Yours comes from beyond the Oort Cloud, and it's much closer.

title: Not the only one listening
text: Mara at The Departure Lounge knows about the nightly signal from beyond the Oort. Someone she knows is listening too.

title: The empty camp at Wolf 359
text: Mara says a mining camp at Wolf 359 was found empty last spring, just like the colony you found.

title: The Vega log
text: The waystation at Vega logs every ship going out past the charts. If they passed through, it'll be there.

title: The Bessel Archive
text: Mara says the Bessel Archive at 61 Cygni pays captains to recover lost records from wrecks and ruins. Tell the archivists Mara sent you.

title: Ask for Ilse Varga
text: Dr. Okafor says the only signal library older than the DSN's is the Bessel Archive at 61 Cygni. Ask for Ilse Varga.

title: The Ninefold
text: A consortium survey tender lost at Wolf 359 twelve years ago. Its last transmission carried the same tone as the core signal. Ilse Varga hired you to recover its flight recorder.

title: Where your drive core came from
text: The Ninefold pulled something big, warm and old out of the Oort Cloud. The consortium built only one ship after that: yours. Your drive core hums when the recorder plays.

title: Tallis Camp
text: Forty-one miners at Wolf 359 built a receiver from the Ninefold's scrap, heard the core, and answered. Their last transmission was the camp's own name, over and over.
